source_documents.title: Excited state dynamics of azulene and its derivatives: The impact of energy gap and vibronic coupling on anti-Kasha emission in solution

reference_evidence_units.subject: Az-Cl / 2-chloroazulene
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 1; same computational level as subsequent dynamics.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Calculated S1/S2 vertical energies are 2.61/3.71 eV, oscillator strengths 0.016/0.017 and gap 1.10 eV.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Vertical gap is not an adiabatic/0-0 energy. Source designation, not confirmed candidate SMILES.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The initial wavefunction is vertically excited into the S2 state at the FC
reference_evidence_units.subject: Az, Az-Cl, Az-OH, Az-NMe2
reference_evidence_units.conditions: F053 LVC/MCTDH two-singlet-state model; TDDFT B3LYP/TZP with COSMO cyclohexane; selected normal modes; first 20 ps after S0-to-S2 excitation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The model initializes S2 at the Franck-Condon geometry and evolves selected nuclear degrees of freedom; convergence checks are described for early propagation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Two excited singlets and selected modes, not full-dimensional S0/S1/S2/triplet/emission dynamics; SI convergence figures not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.subject: Four azulenes; target Az-Cl
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Solution PLQY values from external experimental ref44, quoted in the main text.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Az-Cl is assigned experimental PLQY 0.4% in the source's comparison, with the order Az > Az-Cl > Az-OH > Az-NMe2.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: F053 did not measure these yields anew; original ref44 not inspected. Preserve percent units, especially the very small OH/NMe2 values.

reference_evidence_units.quote: then it reduces to ca. 89 % in the 2.5–8 ps time range and remains so up to 20 ps.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Az-Cl
reference_evidence_units.conditions: F053 LVC/MCTDH two-singlet-state model; TDDFT B3LYP/TZP with COSMO cyclohexane; selected normal modes; first 20 ps after S0-to-S2 excitation. Figure 5 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Az-Cl remains near 98% S2 for 2.5 ps, then falls to 88.8% by 20 ps.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Remaining S2 population at 20 ps is not fluorescence yield, experimental lifetime, or emission intensity.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Stretching along C-Cl bond, which is observed for Q5 and Q9 normal modes of Az-Cl
reference_evidence_units.subject: Az-Cl
reference_evidence_units.conditions: F053 LVC/MCTDH two-singlet-state model; TDDFT B3LYP/TZP with COSMO cyclohexane; selected normal modes; first 20 ps after S0-to-S2 excitation. Main-text description of selected vibrational modes.
reference_evidence_units.statement: C-Cl stretching modes Q5/Q9 add large intrastate couplings. Core modes Q20/Q35/Q40 resemble the important azulene core motions.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Mode assignments/couplings are computational; referenced SI mode tables not personally inspected.

reference_evidence_units.subject: Az-Cl
reference_evidence_units.conditions: F053 LVC/MCTDH two-singlet-state model; TDDFT B3LYP/TZP with COSMO cyclohexane; selected normal modes; first 20 ps after S0-to-S2 excitation. Table 2 and Figure 5 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Turning off Q20/Q35/Q40 raises the S2 population at 20 ps from 88.8% to 94.9%; those modes account for 54.5% of the modeled population loss.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Virtual mode removal is not physical rigidification by aggregation. It isolates only the chosen model degrees of freedom.

reference_evidence_units.quote: both the shape of the curves and the amount of the population loss are different in these simulations
reference_evidence_units.subject: Parent Az with artificially changed energy gaps
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Az Hamiltonian with gap set to 1.10, 0.87 or 0.56 eV, compared with actual derivative Hamiltonians.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The parent-Az gap-only controls do not reproduce substituted compounds; coupling/structure matters as well as gap.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Counterfactual controls on Az, not additional target dynamics or measured target yields.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The rate of the non-radiative decay of the S2 state for all compounds correlates well with the decrease of their anti-Kasha photoluminescence quantum yield
reference_evidence_units.subject: Az and derivatives including Az-Cl
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Comparison of modeled early S2 loss with cited experimental PLQY ordering.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors interpret early S2-to-S1 nonradiative loss and the gap/coupling interplay as determinants of relative anti-Kasha efficiency.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Correlation across four compounds and a 20 ps model, not calculation of absolute radiative yields or definitive exclusive causation.

reference_evidence_units.conditions: Source compound list and Fig.3; crystal emission under ambient conditions.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Compound 2 is designated mFDBP, distinct from representative BDBF compound 3. Fig.3 gives mFDBP lifetime 201 ms and phosphorescence yield 17.7%.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Fig.3 visually inspected. The figure-based lifetime is not extracted from SI; graph correspondence to candidate SMILES remains unverified.

reference_evidence_units.quote: These molecules were found to be non-luminescent in the solution and amorphous states but strongly emissive in the crystalline phase in ambient conditions.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Compounds 1-5, including mFDBP
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Solution, amorphous solid and crystalline states at ambient conditions.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source reports crystallization-induced emission for the named series including compound 2.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A series-level explicit statement; detailed BDBF controls on p.7 are not target-specific measurements on mFDBP.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the vibrational motions are largely suppressed to block the nonradia- tive decay of T1 as a result of the environmental constraint.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Designed arylphenone series including compound 2
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Crystalline state, compared with non-rigid conditions.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors propose that crystalline environmental constraints suppress vibration and nonradiative T1 decay, while reducing oxygen quenching.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A series-level proposed rigidification mechanism, not direct vibrational dynamics or independent proof that mFDBP matches every BDBF control.

reference_evidence_units.quote: molecules 1–3 possessed large aromatic subunits.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Compounds 1-3 including mFDBP
reference_evidence_units.conditions: DFT/TDDFT orbital-character analysis, Fig.4 discussion.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source assigns molecules 1-3 more than 70% pi-pi* character in T1 and links that character to slower phosphorescence decay than the n-pi*-dominated comparators 6-8.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is a subgroup result, not the full BDBF S1/T2 state diagram or mFDBP-specific SOC constant. Full SI computational results were not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The calculated energy gaps between S1 and T1 were considerably large for 1–8 (>0.6 eV)
reference_evidence_units.subject: Calculated molecules 1-8 including mFDBP
reference_evidence_units.conditions: DFT/TDDFT lowest singlet-triplet gaps.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors argue that gaps greater than 0.6 eV block thermally activated reverse ISC and exclude TADF as the explanation for this series' delayed emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This negative finding concerns TADF, not the entire triplet family, which remains supported by phosphorescence.

reference_evidence_units.quote: crystalline powders of mFBDBF (2) showed a more intense green light with a higher FP of 17.7%.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Compound 2, mFDBP
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 365 nm excitation, crystalline powder under ambient conditions; Fig.6.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The reported compound-2 phosphorescence yield is 17.7%; Figure 6B inset independently lists mFDBP at 201 ms and 17.7%.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Fig.6 visually inspected. Prose misspells the abbreviation as mFBDBF; compound number, Fig.3 and Fig.6 identify mFDBP. Do not replace these values with BDBF's 232 ms/34.5%.

reference_evidence_units.quote: No emis- sion decay was detected in the nanosecond range
reference_evidence_units.subject: Synthesized phosphor series including mFDBP
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Nanosecond decay control compared with absence of sample, reported for Fig.S8.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source reports no detected nanosecond emission decay and interprets the synthesized series as pure phosphors.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The detection limit is not stated; Fig.S8 was not inspected. Absence of detectable fast fluorescence does not prove its mathematical absence.

reference_evidence_units.quote: these molecules exhibited bright phosphorescence in solutions
reference_evidence_units.subject: pDBP, mFDBP, FBDBT and ClBCZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 77 K solution and amorphous samples, low-temperature crystals; main-text description of Figs.S5-S7.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source reports low-temperature phosphorescence for compound 2 and the named comparison series even outside the crystalline state.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Only the main-text SI description was read; do not transfer BDBF's detailed temperature spectra or oxygen-control ratios to mFDBP.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The large dependence of tP on bp reveals that the molecular-orbital feature of T1 determines the kP.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Arylphenone phosphor series including mFDBP
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Cross-compound comparison of orbital character, lifetimes and calculated phosphorescence rates.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source's central design argument tunes T1 orbital mixing to balance efficient ISC with a slow radiative phosphorescence rate and long lifetime.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The main mechanistic design argument is orbital-character control of the phosphorescence radiative rate while preserving ISC efficiency; mFDBP is explicitly included in the calculated subgroup.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Persistent pure-organic phosphorescence is supported for compound 2 (201 ms, 17.7%). The family is RTP/ISC, not metal emission or TADF.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the DEST values of TPDC, TPPDC and PPDC are 0.48, 0.35 and 0.27 eV, respectively

reference_evidence_units.statement: PPDC has a calculated singlet-triplet gap of 0.27 eV.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Calculated gaps are not directly measured ISC rates. The interpretation assumes similar spin-orbit couplings across analogues.

reference_evidence_units.quote: close molecular structures suggest a similar amount of spin–orbit coupling between S1 and T1
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPDC, TPPDC and PPDC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Stated molecular-design assumption.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors use approximately comparable spin-orbit coupling to relate gap reduction to increased ISC.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Keep this as an assumption; chemical similarity does not prove equal spin-orbit coupling.

reference_evidence_units.quote: all three compounds are almost non- emissive in pure DMSO and they gradually become emissive
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPDC, TPPDC and PPDC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: DMSO/water series, Figure 2; 10 micromolar as visually checked in the figure caption.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The three compounds show aggregation-associated emission enhancement.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: PDF text extraction corrupts micro to m in some places. No isolated viscosity or motion intervention is reported in this selected evidence.

reference_evidence_units.quote: PPDC, TPPDC and TPDC were calculated to be 0.89, 0.32 and 0.28, respectively
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPDC, TPPDC and PPDC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: ABDA photodegradation relative to Rose Bengal, absorption-normalized quantum yield.
reference_evidence_units.statement: PPDC has a reported singlet-oxygen yield of 0.89.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is a probe-based derived yield, not a direct triplet-population measurement.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the white light irradi- ation on ABDA alone does not lead to an obvious change in absorbance
reference_evidence_units.subject: ABDA-only negative control
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Same white-light conditions as photosensitizer experiments.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The probe-only control does not show the photosensitizer-associated absorbance loss.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This supports photosensitization but does not by itself rule out all probe interferences.

reference_evidence_units.quote: small DEST values can be realized via intramolecular charge transfer within molecular systems containing spatially separated donor and acceptor moieties
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPDC, TPPDC and PPDC design
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Design rationale with target-specific HOMO/LUMO plots in Figure 1.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source uses donor-acceptor charge separation to explain the reduced gap across the series.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This supports a CT design account, not independently verified TICT kinetics.

reference_evidence_units.quote: they were chosen for 1O2 generation comparison in cells
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPDC and PPDC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Cell studies on TAT-functionalized nanoparticle formulations.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Only TPDC and PPDC were selected for the cell comparison.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not attribute those cellular results to TPPDC or to free isolated dyes.

source_documents.title: Saccharin-derived multifunctional emitters featuring concurrently room temperature phosphorescence, thermally activated delayed fluorescence and aggregation-induced enhanced emission

reference_evidence_units.quote: the strong positive solvatochromic effect of the three lumi­ nogens was observed.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6-Cz-Sac, 5-Cz-Sac and DiCz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Solvents n-hexane, toluene, DCM, THF and DMF; spectra discussed with Fig.S14.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors interpret positive solvatochromism across all three emitters as ICT between carbazole and saccharin. DiCz-Sac alone is explicitly quantified as shifting from 445 to 529 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI spectra were not inspected. The 445-to-529 nm shift is not assigned to 5-Cz-Sac or 6-Cz-Sac; no time-resolved charge-transfer kinetics is established.

reference_evidence_units.quote: 348 ms for 6-Cz-Sac, 664 ms for 5-Cz-Sac, and 285 ms for DiCz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.subject: 5-Cz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Crystals synthesized from commercial carbazole, ambient conditions after 365 nm excitation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: 5-Cz-Sac has a reported RTP lifetime of 664 ms and steady-state blue emission peak of 450 nm. Its phosphorescence is dominated by yellow emission around 570 nm with a weak blue component around 470 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Lifetime data are main-text reports of Fig.S16, not inspected SI. Fig.2 on p.5 was visually inspected. These are commercial-feedstock crystal values, not intrinsic purity-independent molecular constants.

reference_evidence_units.quote: All the crystals of Cz-Sac-Lab compounds exhibited phosphorescence emissions under ambient condition with the lifetimes determined to be around 2.5 ms
reference_evidence_units.subject: Cz-Sac-Lab purity controls including 5-Cz-Sac-Lab
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Control syntheses using lab-made carbazole from diphenylamine; Cz-Sac-Lab crystals.
reference_evidence_units.statement: All three lab-carbazole controls retain ambient phosphorescence but have only approximately 2.5 ms lifetimes, far shorter than commercial-carbazole samples.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Approximate series value; do not assign an exact fitted value to any one lab sample. Lifetimes are reported from Fig.S18, which was not inspected; main Fig.2 contrasts lab/commercial spectra.

reference_evidence_units.quote: may be caused by the trace amount of the carbazole isomer
reference_evidence_units.subject: Commercial-carbazole Cz-Sacs and lab-made controls
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Interpretation of the lab-made versus commercial carbazole control.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors provisionally attribute the dramatically extended commercial-feedstock RTP lifetimes to a trace carbazole isomer, while describing millisecond RTP as intrinsic to the lab-made derivatives.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The impurity identity, amount and operative energy/charge-transfer pathway are not demonstrated by this main-text passage. Do not replace 'may' with confirmed causality or infer a host-guest mechanism.

reference_evidence_units.quote: For the dimers of 5-Cz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.subject: 5-Cz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Single-crystal diffraction and packing analysis, Fig.3.
reference_evidence_units.statement: 5-Cz-Sac has carbazole-unit pi stacking at 3.632-3.710 A and C-H...O links at 3.014-3.295 A. Fig.3B-D visually shows its stacked dimer/network.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Packing distance alone does not establish H/J aggregation, excimer emission or the origin of its impurity-sensitive ultralong lifetime.

reference_evidence_units.quote: considered as an efficient pathway to prevent energy loss and stabilize the triplet excitons.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Three Cz-Sac crystals including 5-Cz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Comparison of Cz-Sac crystal interactions, continuing p.5.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors propose compact packing/intermolecular interactions as a triplet-stabilizing contributor and relate packing differences to different RTP lifetimes.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This packing interpretation coexists with the purity-control caveat; it does not override evidence that trace isomers may dominate lifetime extension.

reference_evidence_units.quote: A/B: 6-Cz-Sac; C/D: 5-Cz-Sac; E/F: DiCz-Sac.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 5-Cz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.conditions: THF/water titration, Figure 5 panels C/D; inset UV excitation 365 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: 5-Cz-Sac is emissive in pure THF, weakens sharply on initial water addition, and recovers stronger emission at high water fractions. The target's own panels were visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No cross-compound intensity comparison is made because axes and baseline intensities differ. No digitized enhancement factor or absolute quantum yield is inferred.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The formation of aggregates could effectively block molecular motions and inhibit the
reference_evidence_units.subject: Three Cz-Sac emitters including 5-Cz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.conditions: THF/water aggregates at high water fractions, section 3.6.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors explicitly propose that aggregation blocks molecular motion, including carbazole rotation, and suppresses nonradiative decay to produce AIEE.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is an interpretation of aggregation-dependent spectra, not measured rotational barriers or conical-intersection calculations.

reference_evidence_units.quote: dark twisted intramolecular charge transfer (TICT) states formed with the increase of solvent polarity.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Three Cz-Sac emitters including 5-Cz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Initial water addition versus aggregation at water fraction greater than 80%.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign initial quenching to dark TICT states and subsequent intensity recovery/blue shift to aggregation suppressing motion and reducing solvent relaxation/TICT.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Mixed-solvent polarity and aggregation change together; TICT is an explicit but not uniquely proven assignment. Do not equate this with intermolecular PET.

reference_evidence_units.quote: In contrast, no delayed compo­ nents can be observed for 6-Cz-Sac and 5-Cz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.subject: 5-Cz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Neat-film transient PL, Fig.4D; analogous inert-solution controls described in main text.
reference_evidence_units.statement: 5-Cz-Sac lacks the delayed component observed for DiCz-Sac. The source assigns no TADF under these conditions and reports a spectroscopically estimated S1-T1 gap of 0.28 eV.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Fig.4A-B,D visually inspected. This negative TADF finding does not contradict the target's crystalline RTP or exclude all triplet pathways.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The explicit proposed AIEE mechanism is aggregation restricting internal motion, including carbazole rotation, and reducing nonradiative loss. Spectral recovery is observed; the microscopic attribution remains an author interpretation.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Crystal interactions are explicitly proposed to stabilize triplets and constrain loss. The independent purity control prevents attributing ultralong lifetimes solely to packing.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Keep the source's ICT solvatochromism and dark-TICT quenching interpretation with the solvent/aggregation confound stated.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: RTP is supported, including the short-lived lab-made purity control. TADF is explicitly absent in the tested conditions, so the family must not be described as TADF for this target.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The explicit proposed AIEE mechanism is aggregation restricting internal motion, including carbazole rotation, and reducing nonradiative loss. Spectral recovery is observed; the microscopic attribution remains an author interpretation.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Crystal interactions are explicitly proposed to stabilize triplets and constrain loss. The independent purity control prevents attributing ultralong lifetimes solely to packing.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Trace-isomer dependence is acknowledged, but no direct host binding, inclusion or identified host-guest photophysical pathway is established in the inspected main text.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Keep the source's ICT solvatochromism and dark-TICT quenching interpretation with the solvent/aggregation confound stated.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific excited-state proton-transfer pathway is reported in the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific photoinduced electron-transfer pathway is established; orbital transitions alone are insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Aggregation or close contacts do not by themselves establish an aggregate exciton, excimer, exciplex, or H/J excited state.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The selected evidence does not isolate a distinct radiative-rate or bright/dark-state balance explanation beyond the other explicitly assigned pathways.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: RTP is supported, including the short-lived lab-made purity control. TADF is explicitly absent in the tested conditions, so the family must not be described as TADF for this target.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection-mediated decay or restriction of access is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-state or anti-Kasha emission assignment is established for this target in the selected evidence.

reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is an interpretation of aggregation-dependent spectra, not measured rotational barriers or conical-intersection calculations.

reference_evidence_units.quote: dark twisted intramolecular charge transfer (TICT) states formed with the increase of solvent polarity.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Three Cz-Sac emitters including DiCz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Initial water addition versus aggregation at water fraction greater than 80%.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign initial quenching to dark TICT states and subsequent intensity recovery/blue shift to aggregation suppressing motion and reducing solvent relaxation/TICT.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Mixed-solvent polarity and aggregation change together; TICT is an explicit but not uniquely proven assignment. Do not equate this with intermolecular PET.

reference_evidence_units.quote: DiCz-Sac also shows a distinctive double-exponential decay in the neat film with a delayed lifetime of 3.2 μs
reference_evidence_units.subject: DiCz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Neat film temperature-dependent transient PL, Fig.4E-F; inert/oxygen solution control reported with Fig.S19.
reference_evidence_units.statement: DiCz-Sac exhibits a 3.2 microsecond delayed film component (prompt 18.3 ns shown in Fig.4E) that becomes more evident on warming; its delayed solution component is quenched by oxygen. The authors assign TADF, consistent with a spectroscopic S1-T1 gap of 0.20 eV.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Fig.4E-F visually inspected; oxygen-control SI was not inspected. These film/solution data are distinct from the 285 ms crystal RTP and approximately 2.5 ms lab-carbazole control.

source_documents.title: An AIE Molecule Featured with Changeable Triplet Emission between Phosphorescence and Delayed Fluorescence by External force

reference_evidence_units.quote: Figure 1. Molecular structure of ODFRPTZ.
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Accepted-manuscript Fig.1 and Results opening.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The linked paper's focal emitter is consistently named ODFRPTZ and depicted in Figure 1; this is the provisional source-designation assignment for the manifest's unnamed case.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Fig.1 visually inspected for designation only. This does not establish correspondence of its graph to the unverified legacy SMILES. The synthesis paragraph says dibenzothiophenyl reagent while discussion/figure identify dibenzofuran; resolve with SI.

reference_evidence_units.quote: However, AIE showed up when the water fraction reached 70%.
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: THF/water mixtures, 20 micromolar; Fig.2; UV excitation 365 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: ODFRPTZ is weakly emissive in THF, begins increasing emission around 70% water, and shows stronger yellow emission near 550 nm at high water fractions.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Fig.2 visually inspected. No aggregate size, absolute enhancement factor or triplet assignment is obtained from these spectra alone.

reference_evidence_units.quote: restriction of the intramolecular rotation and vibration
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Aggregation in THF/water, section Results.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign aggregation-enhanced intensity to restriction of internal rotation and vibration reducing nonradiative relaxation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is a proposed microscopic explanation, not direct dynamics or viscosity control. It should not imply that mechanical grinding always suppresses motion.

reference_evidence_units.quote: 540 nm red-shifted 41 nm to 581 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Pristine crystalline versus mechanically ground solid, 365 nm excitation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Grinding removes the short-wavelength band and redshifts the main band; Fig.3 XRD comparison indicates loss of crystallinity.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Fig.3 visually inspected on p.3. Main text additionally reports reversible DCM-vapor recovery and DSC changes in SI, which were not inspected; grinding does not alone prove a specific conformer.

reference_evidence_units.quote: lifetime continuously increased from 0.4 ms at 300 K to 121.1 ms at 77 K
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Pristine crystalline powder, approximately 540 nm emission, temperature-dependent decay.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The delayed component becomes much longer lived on cooling; the source reports 0.4 ms at 300 K and 121.1 ms at 77 K, alongside a fast 8.9 ns component. No visible room-temperature afterglow is reported.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The 8.9 ns decay is reported from SI, not inspected SI. Oxygen enhances triplet sensitivity, but oxygen dependence alone does not distinguish phosphorescence from DF.

reference_evidence_units.quote: emission of ODFRPTZ crystalline powder is composed of prompt fluorescence and phosphorescence
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Temperature-dependent crystalline-powder PL and delayed spectra; main text also reports oxygen response.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign crystalline emission to prompt fluorescence plus phosphorescence using delayed spectra, lifetime increase on cooling and low-temperature afterglow.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not label all delayed emission as TADF. The text's argon/oxygen comparison and figure's air/vacuo labels differ; the reported ratio 2.2 is not treated as a calibrated gas-quenching constant.

reference_evidence_units.quote: strong intermolecular interactions (Figure S14), which effectively decrease the nonradiative decay rates
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Layered crystalline packing, main-text XRD discussion.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors propose that strong packing interactions protect triplet emission from oxygen/thermal deactivation and support the constrained quasi-axial PTZ conformation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Detailed stacking/SI Figs.S13-S15 were not inspected. Main Fig.6 was visually inspected; the interpretation does not independently establish excimer or H/J emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The calculated ΔEST values of isolated monomer, Dimer-1 and Dimer- 2 are 0.73 eV, 0.66 eV and 0.76 eV, respectively.
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Crystal-derived monomer and two dimers, TDDFT B3LYP/6-311+G(d,p).
reference_evidence_units.statement: Computed dimers have more candidate S1-to-Tn channels than the monomer; large S1-T1 gaps are interpreted as unfavorable for RISC, consistent with crystalline phosphorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: These are static state/channel calculations, not ISC/RISC rates. Fig.6 visually inspected; full Table S2/SI was not inspected. Values are not transferred to the ground amorphous material.

reference_evidence_units.quote: fluorescence has a long lifetime of 0.9 μs
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Mechanically ground powder, approximately 580-581 nm; Fig.7 delayed spectrum and decay.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Ground material has a microsecond component reported as 0.9 microseconds and a prompt 18.7 ns component; quantum yield increases from 3.24% to 18.88% after grinding.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Main Fig.7 visually inspected. Authors call the delayed band DF; no ground-powder temperature activation series is established in the inspected source, so the record does not upgrade it to independently proven TADF.

reference_evidence_units.quote: disappearance of the 1LE emission and 20 enhancement of the CT emission.
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Quasi-axial crystalline versus proposed quasi-equatorial ground conformer; assignments section.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign 428 nm to singlet LE, 540 nm to CT(ax) fluorescence plus triplet LE phosphorescence, and 581 nm to CT(eq) prompt/delayed fluorescence after grinding.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The quasi-equatorial ground-state structure is inferred from spectra, quantum yield and analogy rather than directly solved crystallography; the claimed LE/CT redistribution remains a bounded author interpretation.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: RIM is the explicit proposed explanation for solution-to-aggregate enhancement, not an assumption based only on the term AIE.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Crystalline constraints and grinding-induced disorder alter conformation and nonradiative/triplet pathways; this is phase-dependent, not a universal rule that tighter packing is brighter.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source explicitly distinguishes axial and equatorial CT emission and assigns their changing contribution after grinding; exact conformer identification remains inferential.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Conformation-dependent LE/CT and singlet/triplet state balance is an explicit interpretation of spectral switching. This overlaps the CT and triplet labels rather than adding an independent demonstrated cause.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Crystal phosphorescence and ground-powder delayed fluorescence are distinguished by source state and conditions. Ground-powder DF is not asserted to be independently established thermally activated DF.
